snippet.title: [OpenTaiko] Open-World Memories V2: Gleaming Sky | Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Made by @dashydesu  is a trailer showcasing the sequel to the Open-World Memories skin, releasing soon!
Additionally, there are a couple new songs and other small hints at future content hinted in the trailer, so watch carefully!

You can download OpenTaiko here :
https://github.com/0auBSQ/OpenTaiko

OpenTaiko-related socials :
Official discord server : https://discord.gg/aA8scTvZ6B
Official twitter : https://twitter.com/OpenTaiko
